scope: Autonomous follow-up: accurate observation accounting and immutable local evidence.
corrections: Reject malformed canonical review triples before per-question statistics.
Separate mock logical sequences from physical provider attempts/failures.
Serialize review payloads before recording physical dispatch.
Normalize impossible cached-input subtotals without losing other CLI metrics.
Require saved trace lengths/counts/truncation and cached/input metrics to agree.
Preserve immutable run IDs and assessments; equivalent saves remain idempotent, conflicting evidence cannot overwrite.
Validate and snapshot whitelisted usage data on write/read, including legacy scalar limits.
Compare diagnostic object fields independent of key order while preserving array order and rejecting extras.
Use checked token aggregation across ledgers, session summaries, Arena views, History, routing/review experiments; unsupported aggregates become null without inventing usage or prices.
Reject unrepresentable mandatory host request-byte totals without widening or clamping the schema.
